assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production diffuse/albedo texture atlas for a real-time Three.js Chinese study. The attached image is the sole STYLE REFERENCE, not a request to reproduce its scene. Create ONLY a flat orthographic material sheet, 1536x1536 square, exactly FOUR equally tall horizontal rows without gaps or labels, each row 1536x384. No objects or scene, no perspective, no fake spotlight, no extruded edge. Every row is filled edge to edge.
Style strictly matches reference: delicate Chinese gongbi mineral-pigment painting on silk, fine ink outlines, faded ivory, muted celadon, russet pink and dark aged walnut, extraordinarily fine warm matte antique-gold botanical engraving and weathered tiny gold flecks. Flat painted handcrafted surfaces, NOT modern glossy 3D, cartoon, photo or plastic.
ROW 1 (top quarter): a magnificent wide rectangular dark warm brown/walnut carved altar-table front apron, extremely intricate densely interwoven matte antique-gold peony vines, auspicious leaves, elegant fine scrollwork and central peony medallion. This is the rich dark carved wood and gold of the reference desk front. Tiny timeworn pigment flecks and hand-drawn contours; straight-on texture only, NO table legs, NO borders casting shadows.
ROW 2: aged dark walnut tabletop surface painted with a finer restrained repeated peony vine gold pattern, subtle linear wood-grain and small worn mineral gold flecks, balanced fine density. Top-down flat surface only, NO perspective/no edges.
ROW 3: dark grey-celadon lacquered wood window lower-panel material with highly refined gold peony vine ornament, symmetrical gold fine-line medallions and small cloud curls, delicately aged. Flat front surface only.
ROW 4 (bottom quarter): translucent warm ivory lantern silk with delicately painted pink/cinnabar peony branches, small grey-green leaves and sparse tiny matte gold flecks, elegant sparse balanced composition on cream paper fibres. No lantern body, ribs or hardware, only flat silk material.
No Chinese characters, no letters, no numbers, no seams/gaps between four equal rows, no website, no title, no buttons, no room. High precision decorative art so close inspection still reveals elegant very fine linework. Retain the reference's art direction faithfully.
assets.transformation: PNG copied byte-for-byte, WebP encoding only; no image content edits

assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: three independent painted peony bloom albedo cutouts for gently cupped three-dimensional flower geometry in an interactive Chinese study. Attached image is the only STYLE REFERENCE. Create a horizontal 1536x1024 PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, exactly THREE separate flower heads evenly centered left, middle, right, each entirely contained within its own third of the canvas, with generous transparent margin. The flowers MUST NOT touch or overlap one another.
Left third: a large fully open blush-pink peony flower crown, many delicately layered curling petals, warm cream-pink edges and soft deeper rose inner folds, fine mineral pigment strokes and careful ink contours.
Middle third: a large fully open traditional cinnabar/crimson peony crown with warm vermilion and carmine petals, small ochre-gold stamens, velvety shaded folds but no photographic realism.
Right third: a large fully open pale ivory/cream peony crown with extremely subtle blush petal tips, fine pale ochre contours and a small ochre-gold stamen heart.
All three should be nearly frontal/circular/fully open with equal visual diameter and the central hearts visible. Use almost the full height of each 512px-wide column but do not cross the column boundaries. No stems; at most one or two tiny subtle grey-green sepals behind the edge of each flower, NO large leaves.
Strictly preserve the reference's exquisite hand-painted Chinese gongbi style: hundreds of fine petals drawn with thin warm ink lines, layered mineral-pigment washes, weathered silk-like painterly surface, restrained opaque color and occasional microscopic old-gold specks on a few petal edges. High-detail classical botanical painting. NOT a 3D render, NOT faceted folded paper, NOT watercolor blobs, NOT a photograph, NOT clipart, NOT cartoon. No room, no scene, no vase, no plaque, no text, no border, no paper rectangle, no cast shadow, no glow, no green/black/white background or checkerboard; completely transparent pixels around the exact irregular flower silhouettes.
assets.transformation: PNG copied byte-for-byte; WebP encoding only, generated alpha preserved; no image content edits
